description: This PHP class implements the UploadedFileInterface for handling uploaded files, providing methods to access file attributes, move files, and manage upload errors within the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 package.

classes.name: UploadedFile
classes.description: A class that represents an uploaded file, including metadata and methods for moving the file and retrieving its properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an UploadedFile instance with stream or file, size, error status, and optional filename and media type.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the stream of the uploaded file, throwing exceptions if the file has errors or has been moved.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a specified target path, handling various conditions and errors.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename sent by the client.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type sent by the client.
